title: Jewbuntu startup jingle - 8-bit Hava Nagila
about: Original chiptune arrangement of the opening phrase of the traditional melody. Edit the notes here, then run 'make sounds' (or python3 assets/sounds/synth.py ...) to re-render.
transcription_note: Melody transcribed from memory of the traditional tune in D freygish (D Eb F# G A Bb C). Verify by ear and correct here if any note is off.
